projects.name: LabQuest
projects.summary: A classroom workspace for running lab programs, grading submissions and tracking attendance.
projects.problem: Checking repeated lab submissions takes time away from teaching.
projects.solution: Bring faculty-managed tasks, a student editor and test-case feedback into one lab session.
projects.implementation: The project scope includes separate faculty and student workflows. No public release has been verified.
projects.challenge: Keep untrusted student programs isolated and hidden test cases private.
projects.future: Validate the complete session workflow with a lab class.

projects.name: DeployHub
projects.summary: An infrastructure project exploring how applications move from source code to deployment.
projects.problem: Deployment steps can be difficult to inspect and repeat.
projects.solution: Explore a repeatable workflow from source to a running service.
projects.implementation: Development is tracked privately. Public implementation and hosting details are unavailable.
projects.future: Publish a verified architecture and deployment walkthrough.

projects.name: AI Resume Analyser
projects.summary: A résumé analysis workspace that compares a candidate’s experience with a job description.
projects.problem: Candidates need to understand which parts of a job description their résumé addresses.
projects.solution: Compare résumé text and job criteria, then expose skill gaps and a learning roadmap.
projects.implementation: The public repository documents PDF and DOCX parsing, TF-IDF similarity, weighted scoring and a React dashboard.
projects.challenge: Explain keyword coverage alongside the underlying match score.
projects.future: Evaluate scoring against a broader sample of job descriptions.

projects.name: Saaf Bharath
projects.summary: An air-quality prediction and awareness project connecting pollutant trends to everyday decisions.
projects.problem: Air-quality measurements can be difficult to interpret in daily life.
projects.solution: Study pollutant and weather histories to forecast AQI and communicate trends.
projects.implementation: Research scope includes forecasting and visualization. Public model benchmarks and hosting are unverified.
projects.challenge: Account for missing observations and changes across locations.
projects.future: Publish a reproducible evaluation and example forecasts.
